name: pii-filter
description: Automatic, local PII filtering with Microsoft Presidio (Dutch + English) on every file Claude reads: data files, documents (pdf/docx/pptx/xlsx) and code/markdown with personal data give Claude a pseudonymised copy (<PERSON_1>, <NL_BSN_1>, ...), recognising many Dutch spellings of phone numbers, postcodes, BSN, IBAN, addresses, places and birth dates. Raw shell/Grep views of data files are blocked and the local vault with real values stays off-limits. Personal data that still slips through is reported automatically as an AVG datalek in BRIDGE ISMS, stating what leaked, how, and an assessment of the meldplicht (privacy officer is e-mailed by BRIDGE). Works for subagents too.
